title: The info icon on COD explains the term on hover
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure all twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps: 1. Hover the info icon after the name "COD".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • After the name "COD" there is an info icon and then a lock icon.
  • Hovering the info icon shows: "Cash on delivery. COD customers can't charge to account, so payment is taken when the invoice is created."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R8: “COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold each show, after the name, an info icon and a lock icon. Hovering the info icon shows:”
  • S1-R8, COD info icon: “COD: "Cash on delivery. COD customers can't charge to account, so payment is taken when the invoice is created."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover the info icon on COD | "Cash on delivery. COD customers can't charge to account, so payment is taken when the invoice is created." | Tooltip on hover”
  • Key Decisions: “The page explains every term inline in a Due column; only COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold carry an info tooltip.”
